name: 66606 · Topeka, KS
findings: ZIP 66606 (Topeka) has 58 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 23 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 66606 (Topeka) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
52% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
